scroll: TAPE 01 [00:12] You have been selected for the Program. Walk forward. Do not look for the camera.
TAPE 01 [01:05] Doors are provided. Keys are provided. This is not a metaphor.
TAPE 01 [01:58] Some footage of this wing is missing. This is normal. Continue.
TAPE 01 [02:41] A figure has entered frame. It is DESIGNATION 01. It has always been here. Do not greet it.
TAPE 01 [03:30] The ceiling in the east passage was measured incorrectly on purpose. Duck.
TAPE 01 [04:12] Some of the floor was removed during a previous intake. It was not replaced.
TAPE 01 [05:03] DESIGNATION 01 will not deviate from its route. You are permitted to.
TAPE 01 [05:47] Orientation is complete. Tape 02 introduces personnel. Do not skip ahead.

TAPE 01 [07:10] ANOMALY: UNLISTED. This entity has not been assigned a designation. It appears only in doorways. We do not know where it goes when it is not in one. When a door begins to glow, do not be in front of it.
boss_lore: RECOVERED LOG -- INTAKE
Entity first logged in a stairwell doorway. No one was found nearby. The door had not been opened from either side.
REVIEW NOTE
We stopped assigning it a number after the third subject who saw it stopped answering to their own name.

scroll: TAPE 02 [04:40] This is DESIGNATION 01. It walks the same eleven steps it has always walked. Do not interrupt its count.
TAPE 02 [05:22] More than one DESIGNATION 01 has been logged in this hallway. They do not acknowledge each other. Neither should you.
TAPE 02 [06:10] DESIGNATION 01 has been observed on elevated surfaces. The floor was never guaranteed to be safer.
TAPE 02 [09:03] DESIGNATION 02 is a disturbance in the signal shaped like a person. It rises and falls with the interference. Cross during a clean frame.
TAPE 02 [09:51] DESIGNATION 02 will occasionally drop to floor level. Do not be under it when the signal breaks.
TAPE 02 [10:36] Two instances of DESIGNATION 02 have been recorded moving out of sync with each other. This has not been explained.
TAPE 02 [11:20] DESIGNATION 01 and DESIGNATION 02 have been observed sharing a corridor. Neither is aware of the other. You should be aware of both.
TAPE 02 [12:08] The dust in this hallway was tested. The results were not released to new intake.
TAPE 02 [12:59] Some doors here are monitored from the other side. This is for your protection. We will not say whose.
TAPE 02 [13:44] Intake is complete. Your file has been updated. Tape 03 was recorded below ground level.
TAPE 02 [15:40] ANOMALY: THE PROJECTOR. It watches one row of this hall and, without warning at first, sends everything in that row back out as static. Do not approach while its screen is lit.
boss_lore: RECOVERED LOG
Before it was called the Projector, it was a television left running in an empty room, on a loop no one here made.
REVIEW NOTE
It does not record what it sees. It only shows what is already there, slightly late.

scroll: TAPE 03 [15:21] DESIGNATION 03 presents as dormant. It is not sleeping. It is waiting for a reason. Do not give it one.
TAPE 03 [19:48] DESIGNATION 04 does not move. It records. It transmits what it records back to us. Stay out of frame.
TAPE 03 [21:02] DESIGNATION 03 responds to proximity, not to sound, not to light. Distance is the only known deterrent.
TAPE 03 [21:55] DESIGNATION 03 moves slower than an average intake subject. This has been confirmed. Do not confirm it personally.
TAPE 03 [22:40] Two units of DESIGNATION 04 have overlapping fields of view. There is no angle that is watched by neither.
TAPE 03 [23:31] DESIGNATION 01 is not aware DESIGNATION 03 has been activated in this sector. DESIGNATION 03 does not care either way.
TAPE 03 [24:15] A DESIGNATION 01 unit and a DESIGNATION 04 unit have been placed in the same corridor deliberately. Study the DESIGNATION 01's timing. The 04 cannot be reasoned with.
TAPE 03 [25:09] Once DESIGNATION 03 activates, DESIGNATION 04 will not pause its recording to let it pass. Elevated surfaces are recommended for both.
TAPE 03 [26:20] DESIGNATION 03 was logged under a name before it was assigned a number. The name has been removed from this file. Please do not ask for it.
TAPE 03 [27:02] (a second voice, underneath) -- they didn't take me. I walked down here myself. I want that on the record.
TAPE 03 [29:40] ANOMALY: THE CALLER. It does not act directly. It waits, and it calls something else in. What answers does not last long, but it does not need to.
boss_lore: RECOVERED LOG
It was found with its arms raised, before anyone heard it make a sound. We do not know what it is calling. Only that something answers.
REVIEW NOTE
What it calls in does not outlast it by much. That has not made it easier to be near.

scroll: TAPE 04 [22:47] You are now below the level shown on your intake map. Please disregard your intake map.
TAPE 04 [22:12] All four Designations have been logged active in this sector simultaneously. This has never happened before. It is happening now.
TAPE 04 [22:50] The lamp in this room flickers on a fixed interval. The interval matches something. We have not said what.
TAPE 04 [21:38] Recessed alcoves along this corridor are outside both units' recorded range. Use them. Do not linger in them.
TAPE 04 [23:01] DESIGNATION 02 and DESIGNATION 04 have begun operating together. One moves. One watches. We did not program this.
TAPE 04 [19:59] [TIMECODE ERROR] -- someone is narrating faster now. I don't think there's much tape left. I don't think that's about the tape.
TAPE 04 [23:44] If the corridor below you is silent, that is not a good sign. DESIGNATION 02 does not make noise until it is close.
TAPE 04 [20:14] The sound underneath this recording is not the building. Please continue as though it is the building.
TAPE 04 [24:03] [TIMECODE ERROR] You flinch at footsteps I cannot hear on this side of the tape. A door opens that was not on the floor plan.
TAPE 04 [19:33] There is no marked exit from this floor. There is only the next room. This has been true the entire time.
TAPE 04 [24:59] Unlisted Floor documentation is complete. Do not file a report. Tape 05 is the last approved recording.
TAPE 04 [26:50] ANOMALY: THE GUARDIAN. Plated. Slow. It does not react to being approached from directly above. We have no explanation for why that is the one place it does not defend.
boss_lore: RECOVERED LOG
It has never left this room. It has never reacted to anyone who approached from above. We do not know why.
REVIEW NOTE
Early staff assumed it was guarding something. The room has always been empty.

scroll: TAPE 05 [--:--] Please remain calm. Please remain exactly where you are. We are almost finished here.
TAPE 05 [--:--] [TIMECODE ERROR] The walls hold on to things the residents cannot. That was never meant as a threat. It was meant kindly.
TAPE 05 [--:--] Designations 01 through 04 were never four separate recordings. We edited them to look that way. We are sorry.
TAPE 05 [--:--] [TIMECODE ERROR] I am not the only one in this building holding on past the point I should have stopped.
TAPE 05 [--:--] Continue. This is the same room as before. It has always been the same room. Continue anyway.
TAPE 05 [--:--] You keep finding a door. It is never the correct one. We do not know how many more there are.
TAPE 05 [--:--] Please slow your breathing to match the sound underneath this tape. It will be easier that way.
TAPE 05 [--:--] It is permitted to be tired. Everyone who is waiting for you already knows that, somewhere, in a much quieter room.
TAPE 05 [--:--] [TIMECODE ERROR] Listen. Under the recording. Under everything we have shown you tonight. There is a steady sound. It has been there since Tape 01.
TAPE 05 [--:--] The Warden was never given a number. There is no guidance for what happens next. Please proceed anyway.
boss_lore: RECOVERED LOG -- FINAL ENTRY
The Warden was never completed as its own Designation. Pieces of all four were used, because there was no time left to build a fifth.
REVIEW NOTE
It is the only thing in this building we did not make on purpose.
UNSIGNED
If you are reading this, the tape is still running. That was not supposed to be possible.
